Training

.. py:module:: graph_recc_sys.engine_modules.training

.. py:class:: Training(train_subgraph: ~torch_geometric.data.hetero_data.HeteroData, train_loader: ~torch_geometric.loader.link_neighbor_loader.LinkNeighborLoader, val_loader: ~torch_geometric.loader.link_neighbor_loader.LinkNeighborLoader, val_subgraph: ~torch_geometric.data.hetero_data.HeteroData) :module: graph_recc_sys.engine_modules.training

Bases: :py:class:~graph_recc_sys.utils.config.DataClass

Helper class that manages the training and validation steps for the recommendation model.

This class supports two training regimes:

  • binary training, where the model predicts edge logits and optimizes a classification loss

  • contrastive / triplet training, where the model outputs embeddings and optimizes a metric-learning loss over anchor-positive-negative triplets

It stores references to the train/validation subgraphs and loaders, keeps track of the current learning rate, and exposes internal methods used by the engine during training.

.. attribute:: train_subgraph

  Training subgraph used during optimization.

  :type: HeteroData

.. attribute:: train_loader

  Mini-batch loader used for training.

  :type: LinkNeighborLoader

.. attribute:: val_loader

  Mini-batch loader used for validation.

  :type: LinkNeighborLoader

.. attribute:: val_subgraph

  Validation subgraph used for validation-time computations.

  :type: HeteroData

.. attribute:: current_lr

  Most recently used learning rate.

  :type: float | None

.. attribute:: loss_fn

  Loss function assigned externally by the training engine.

  :type: torch.nn.Module | None
